entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No. 253 of 2018, registered under Sections 452, 354, 376, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 7/8 POCSO Act, at Police Station- Jalaun, District- Jalaun with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

5. As per prosecution story, the informant had instituted an FIR against the applicant pertaining to outraging her modesty on 9.7.2018 at about 05:00 p.m. when she had gone to market alongwith her younger sister.
6. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case.

The allegations have been inflated by the victim herein during her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., whereby she has stated that the applicant had committed rape with her by intoxicating her and the applicant is stated to have kept on entering into corporeal relationship with her and prepared video clip of it.
The applicant is also stated to have threatened the informant to make the video viral.
Learned counsel has further stated that even the members of the locality have not supported the prosecution story regarding outraging of her modesty.
The victim has not been medically examined.

Learned counsel has further stated that the victim is admittedly 20 years of age at the time of offence and the case under the POCSO Act has been added after legal consultation as the offence of rape has been shown to have occurred three years back.

7. Learned counsel for the applicant has further stated that the applicant was granted interim protection by this Court vide order dated 26.4.2019 passed in Application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. No.16683 of 2019, but in the light of judgment of the Apex Court in Asian Resurfacing of Road Agency Private Limited and Another vs. Central Bureau of Investigation, (2018) 16 SCC 299 the said interim protection stood vacated.

entities.text: Asian Resurfacing of Road Agency Private Limited and Another vs. Central Bureau of Investigation, (2018) 16 SCC 299
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant has no criminal history to his credit.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
The applicant has apprehension of his arrest.

Learned counsel has stated that the applicant undertakes that he has co-operated in the investigation and is ready to do so in trial also failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail.
8.
Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail application but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant.

9. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant, the applicant is liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicant shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.
10. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
